Legal Notice & Disclosures

Privacy Policy

Effective Date: October 20, 2026 | Last Updated: October 20, 2026

1. Information We Collect

This website does not currently send contact, demo, project, or newsletter form data to a Nirvoxa server. When you use a mail link or submit a form, your browser opens a pre-filled email draft; you decide whether to send it. If you email us, Nirvoxa IT Solutions Private Limited ("Nirvoxa", "we", "our", or "us") receives the information included in that email.

  • Contact Identifiers: Name, business email, telephone/WhatsApp number, company name.
  • Project Specifications: Selected software modules, estimated users, operational bottlenecks, budget preferences.
  • Theme preference: Your selected display theme is stored in browser local storage.
  • Technical requests: The website host and external font provider may receive standard connection data when your browser requests pages or fonts. Check their notices for details.

2. How We Use Collected Information

Information you choose to email us may be used to:

  • Scheduling and conducting interactive product demonstrations tailored to your industry.
  • Preparing commercial software proposals and architectural roadmaps.
  • Responding to technical customer support requests.
  • Follow up about the request you sent.

3. Client Data Sovereignty & Confidentiality

Do not include passwords, payment credentials, health records, or other sensitive personal information in a website inquiry. Email is handled by the email services you and Nirvoxa use; their own privacy terms also apply. Any project data handling must be agreed separately in writing.

4. Security Standards

This website does not provide a form-submission backend. Email security depends on the mail applications and providers involved. Specific security controls for a product or project should be confirmed in its written agreement; this page does not make a certification or encryption guarantee.

5. Your Rights & Privacy Inquiries

For a privacy question or to request access to, correction of, or deletion of information you emailed us, contact contact@nirvoxaitsolutions.com.
